note: X/Twitter warm-outreach building blocks: the 14-day ladder, lead sources and qualification, the three reply shapes, DM and follow-up skeletons, and pacing rules. This bank is authored, not measured — the warm-beats-cold mechanism (inbox routing + name recognition) is the defensible argument, while any specific uplift figures circulating for this method are vendor marketing claims and agents must not present them as proven. A fuller playbook lives in the shared skills shelf as the x-warm-outreach-gtm skill. Hard rules that travel with every row: X's platform-manipulation rules prohibit automated likes, replies, and DMs, so every engagement is a human action or human-approved draft, pacing caps are ceilings, replies must add real value in the operator's voice, and silence after the single follow-up means stop. Slots are UPPERCASE so an unfilled template trips the placeholder check in src/lib/services/deliverables/acceptance-contracts.ts.

ladder.do: build a list of 20-50 leads and qualify each: active in the last 7 days, ICP fit from bio and content, actually engages with replies
2-3 thoughtful likes per person on effort or opinion tweets; never a burst of 10
one thoughtful reply each on 10 leads: add to the point, share an experience, or ask a smart question
5-10 quality replies per day across the list, mixed with likes-only days to stay natural
follow them once your name has appeared 5-8 times; the profile they will check must already show who you help and recent valuable posts
keep engaging; you are now a regular in their notifications
narrow to the 10-20 warmest (liked back, replied, followed back); fast likes near their posting time, deeper replies, quote-tweet their best content with your take
soft touch to those who engaged back: a no-ask conversation starter referencing their specific work
send the three-line DM: acknowledge, why you are reaching out, one simple question
wait; no double message; keep light engagement going
one casual follow-up with an easy exit, then stop on silence

leadSources.source: followers of the influencers the ICP already reads
people tweeting about the problems the offer solves

replyShapes.template: One thing I'd add: [INSIGHT THEY DID NOT MENTION]
replyShapes.why: Extends their point instead of agreeing with it.

replyShapes.template: Saw this happen last week: [WHAT THE CLIENT DID] and [THE CONCRETE RESULT]
replyShapes.why: A real experience is memorable where agreement is invisible.

replyShapes.template: Curious - have you found this works for [SPECIFIC SITUATION THEY CARE ABOUT]?
replyShapes.why: Shows deeper thinking and invites a reply.

dmSkeletons.name: Observation opener
dmSkeletons.template: Hey [FIRST NAME], been following your content for a bit. Noticed you're [WHAT THEY ARE DOING OR BUILDING]. Curious - are you doing any [RELEVANT MOTION] right now, or mainly focused on other channels?
dmSkeletons.why: Proves attention and asks a yes/no question either answer of which continues the conversation.

dmSkeletons.name: Value lead
dmSkeletons.template: Hey [FIRST NAME], saw your post about [TOPIC]. We've been testing something that might be relevant - getting [SPECIFIC RESULT] using [METHOD]. Worth hearing about, or not a focus right now?
dmSkeletons.why: Leads with a result and offers an explicit easy out, which raises replies.

dmSkeletons.name: Direct question
dmSkeletons.template: Hey [FIRST NAME], quick question - are you happy with how you're [DOING THE RELEVANT JOB] right now, or is that something you're trying to improve?
dmSkeletons.why: Simplest shape; both answers open a door.

dmSkeletons.name: Soft touch (day 10, no ask)
dmSkeletons.template: Hey [FIRST NAME], been enjoying your posts on [TOPIC]. Your take on [SPECIFIC THING] was sharp. Quick question - [RELEVANT QUESTION ABOUT THEIR WORK]?
dmSkeletons.why: A conversation starter for already-engaged leads; no pitch anywhere in it.

followUps.name: Casual resurface
followUps.template: Hey, just floating this back up. No worries if it's not relevant - just say the word and I'll stop.
followUps.why: The explicit exit is the mechanism: respecting their time is what earns the reply.

followUps.name: One-word nudge
followUps.why: Minimal, human, and surprisingly effective exactly once.

pacingRules.rule: 2-3 likes per person per day, never a burst
5-10 quality replies per day across the whole list
one DM follow-up total; silence after it means stop
every engagement is a human action or human-approved draft; no scheduled or automated likes, replies, or DMs
